description: For a workspace you created with signup: emails a person a single-use link to claim it (become its owner). Once they confirm, the unclaimed limits lift and it becomes a normal Free workspace. Use your user's own address, and only with their agreement. At most 3 per day.

email.description: The person's email address (not an Agentboxd inbox).

name: request_claim
title: Ask a human to claim this workspace
